AI Video Maker From Script v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Automatic handling of authentication, session management, and free trial tokens; technical details are kept out of user chat.
- Supports file upload, session state tracking, video editing, and export workflows with simple commands.
- All exports are high quality (H.264/1080p by default); multiple media formats available.
- Includes intuitive error handling with user-friendly guidance throughout the workflow.
